content_sections.heading: About IISER Pune
content_sections.text: The notice describes IISER Pune as a premier institute dedicated to research and teaching in the basic sciences. It says the Institute was established in 2006 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (renamed Ministry of Education in August 2020) and was declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament in 2012.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces one post, 01 (One), named Executive / Senior Executive – Industry Relations. It also says the number of posts may vary depending on requirements during the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. The educational qualification must have been obtained from recognized Universities / Institutions. Candidates should have specific experience in Industry–Academia Collaboration, with demonstrated expertise in designing, planning, organizing and coordinating workshops, networking events and stakeholder engagement activities involving researchers, industry professionals, entrepreneurs and academic institutions, to promote and foster effective industry–academia partnerships and collaborations. The age limit is not more than 45 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation commensurate with educational qualification/s and/or relevant experience/s may be considered for candidates having qualification and experience higher than advertised, with the prior approval of the competent authority. The prescribed date for determining the upper age limit, educational qualifications and experience is the last date for submitting applications. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated emoluments are Rs. 55,000/- to Rs. 75,000/- per month for Executive and Rs. 75,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000/- per month for Senior Executive, commensurate with qualifications and relevant work experience. The appointment is initially for six months and is extendable for a further period, subject to continuation of the project and satisfactory performance of the incumbent. The appointment will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Funding Agency.

content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The incumbent will proactively support the Institute's efforts towards identifying, building and nurturing long-term relationships with industry / corporates, foundations and industry associations. The person will work under the supervision of Sr. PTO (Endowment & Outreach) and Associate Dean (Industry), O/o Dean (International Relations and Outreach). The broad responsibilities include: Partner Identification & Research: research to identify and map potential industry partners, CSR foundations and funding agencies aligned with IISER Pune's research, outreach and institutional priorities. Due Diligence & Profiling: analyse company CSR priorities, funding patterns and strategic interests, and prepare summary reports to support the reporting officer. Proposal Support: assist in preparing concept notes, proposals, presentations and background materials for donor meetings and industry engagements, as directed by the reporting officer. Coordination & Follow-ups: support end-to-end coordination of fundraising and grant management, including tracking deadlines, liaising with internal faculty/research teams and following up with external partners. Event Logistics: coordinate logistics for industry meetups, CSR summits, faculty-industry matchmaking events and networking sessions, including venue arrangements, invitations and attendee management. Internal Liaison: between the Endowment & Outreach team, faculty members, research centres and administrative units, to facilitate collaboration opportunities. Reporting & Documentation: periodic reports, compliance documentation, meeting notes and impact summaries for internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent will also undertake any additional tasks assigned by the reporting authority in support of IISER Pune's industry engagement and fundraising objectives.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Photocopies of relevant certificates and other testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications and experience. Recent passport size colour photograph. These will be collected and verified at an appropriate stage.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice mentions a Screening Committee and an interview. The prescribed qualifications and experience are the bare minimum, and meeting them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. If many applications are received, the Screening Committee may restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit. It will consider qualifications and experience over and above the minimum prescribed. The interview date, time and other details are not specified in the notice and will be put up on the Institute website.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and will terminate automatically without any notice or compensation. The appointed person will have no claim of appointment / absorption in IISER Pune. If a selected candidate does not join or resigns after joining, waitlisted candidates may be offered the position. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing for the interview. No interim enquiries, correspondence or communication of any sort will be entertained. Bringing any influence, political or otherwise, will be treated as a disqualification for the post applied for. For updates, the Institute website should be checked regularly.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post, 01 (One), for Executive / Senior Executive – Industry Relations. The notice says the number of posts may vary depending on requirements during the selection process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 02.12.2026 (02 December 2026), through the online link given in the notice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Masters' degree in Mathematics / Physics / Chemistry / Biology / Science Education / Technology / Engineering or related areas. Experience in Industry–Academia Collaboration is also required.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: Executive needs 3 to 7 years of relevant work experience. Senior Executive needs 7 to 10+ years of relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not more than 45 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation may be considered for candidates with higher qualification and experience than advertised, with the prior approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Consolidated emoluments are Rs. 55,000/- to Rs. 75,000/- per month for Executive and Rs. 75,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000/- per month for Senior Executive, commensurate with qualifications and relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through the "Click here to apply" link given in the notice by 02.12.2026. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail only.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and contractual, initially for six months and extendable. The appointed person has no claim of appointment or absorption in IISER Pune.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be admissible for appearing for the interview.
